title: SteadyCheck: anomaly-driven accuracy guardian for FP8/INT8 rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and build SteadyCheck, an automated accuracy validation harness that flags anomalous regressions during FP8/INT8 calibration and rollout. The harness will run targeted golden-prompt cohorts and live-like samples, compute multi-dimensional metrics (embedding cosine, logprob delta, token-level perplexity proxy, structured-output schema match, and hallucination score), and evaluate dynamic pass/fail gates. It must integrate with the calibration pipeline to accept quant profiles, run contextual cohorts, and emit deterministic artifacts for auditing and rollback decisions. The goal is to catch subtle semantic degradations that simple token-level deltas miss, and to provide actionable failure reasons for SRE/ML owners.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can execute a configurable suite of golden cohorts and live-sampled cohorts end-to-end against FP8 and INT8 candidate builds
At least five metric dimensions computed per run: embedding cosine (reference model), avg token logprob delta, top-k token divergence, schema validation pass rate, hallucination indicator
Configurable pass/fail policy: per-cohort thresholds and weighted scoring that produces a single PASS/FLAG/FAIL decision
Automated artifact generation: drift report (CSV/JSON), per-prompt diffs, sample-level signal tags, and dashboard links
Integration with rollout controller: a webhook that can trigger blocked canary, rollback, or continue based on decision
Telemetry: emits Prometheus and structured event logs for every run with run_id and model_version tags
Run time budget: full golden-suite execution for typical 1k-prompt suite completes within target 15 minutes on CI/gpu-ci and within 3 minutes on Dedicated infra using batching
Operator UX: a minimal UI page (Console link) showing top 10 failing prompts, metric histograms, and recommended remediation steps
